nom: The Ordinary Multi-Peptide Eye Serum for Wrinkles and Crow's Feet

avis.titre: I have bought several bottles of Multi-Peptide Eye Serum
avis.texte: I think it works for wrinkles and crow's feet. I'm 65 and I don't have many wrinkles. It did reduce my dark under eye circles. It is a good product that I will keep buying.

I've been using this eye serum for 4 years now and is the best purchase I've ever made. I'm 60 and the skin around ny eyes looks plump, healthy and younger for my age. I use it day and night right after washing my face and before any serum or cream. Love love love 👌
I bought this and was very disappointed. I DON'T have sensitive skin at all and have never had a negative reaction to new skincare, but this left sore bumps around my eyes! I will not be using again
This eye serum is super drying and made my eyes irritated. I had the same issue with their lash serum too!
I can totally tell a huge difference in appearance of wrinkles. I will most likely use this product until it's discontinued.

The ONLY Ordinary product that is an absolute miss. This stuff burns/stings, and if you accidentally get any IN your eyes, game over. Did I mention it BURNS? Do better, Ordinary - we deserve a better eye treatment from you.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: Love eye serum, I'm 66 and Iike How under my eyes change since I begin use this product Tks

I really like the consistency of the product because I'm not a fan of lotions due to them being so thick. However, I'm not sure if it's the best for dark circles. I'm not sure how long it takes, but I've been using it for a week now.

avis.titre: I would use this product again & again
avis.texte: I used it for 4 bottles now … the line below my eyes becomes better and less line … I would recommend this product to any one … I really satisfied with this product …

avis.titre: Does not work for under eyes
avis.texte: Under eyes remained rhe same. The peoduct does not help with the appearance of dark circles. Helps not have dry under eyes, but darkness remains
I love "The Ordinary" products 😍 they work really well for me I use almost all they're line! I can tell the difference almost immediately when I first used them. Now they are my go to.

Ive had to strip down my skincare routine because I introduced tret, but this eye serum I continue to use. It's more expensive than more of the other Ordinary products, but lasts me five months. So I only have to buy this a few times per year

I'm 40 and dealing with dry skin on my eyes to the point of dermatitis or eczema. I'm paying $150 for eye creams that don't work. I added this and surprisingly it works better than anything else. It's also fungal acne safe so I don't have to worry about it. I still am searching for a cream to go on top to make it last longer but on its own, its lasting longer than my creams, but still doesn't last 8+ hours. I have crepey drooping lids by the end of the day still but def less uncomfortable now.
This serum works as well as, maybe better than, anything I've ever used on the wrinkles around my eyes. it truly tightens the skin.
This is very hydrating and there is no irritation to my area.

I was surprised to see the poor reviews. I have had a positive experience in a short amount of time. My eyes feel less baggy and puffy, and my skin tone is brighter and more even around my eyes. I will say this is a more intense treatment-i use literally one drop per side, and im careful not to apply near the wet areas of my eye. It burns like you know what if it gets in contact with your eye at all.

I was reluctant to try this serum due to the reviews, but I am a fan of The Ordinary products and had to try it for myself. I was not disappointed. The serum is not oily and a little goes a long way. I've been using it for about 2 weeks and there's definitely been an improvement in my wrinkles. My under eye area looks a lot smoother & brighter. I've used numerous more expensive under eye creams, but none have done such a good job as this serum. Everyone has different allergic skin reactions, so maybe you should try a sample of it first, but Indid NOT have any problems whatsoever.

I've been using this serum for about 2 years. It noticeably improved fine lines around my eyes, and helps a bit with puffiness. I used to wear a moisturizer over the serum, but tried it on its own without moisturizer during the day. It works so well on its own. My under eye concealer goes on like a dream, and because the serum is not oily, my concealer creases much less. now this is the only product I use around my eyes under makeup. I am prone to milia around my eyes when I wear moisturizers. That is a problem solved by using this serum. I do use moisturizer over the serum at night.

avis.titre: Like the fact that it is a multi peptide serum
avis.texte: My husband uses this daily and is seeing a reduction in fine lines. I tried it once and it stung my skin so I finally had to wash it off. I have sensitive skin. It's not the Ordinary, it's me.

I absolutely LOVE The Ordinary!!! With these inexpensive products, you can put together a personalized skin care regimen that meets your exact needs without paying for a lot of ingredients you probably don't need and/or going through some expensive customization service. I combine The Ordinary with COSRX Snail Mucin products and a Mario Badescu toner for the best results. Granted, my regimen consists of about a dozen products, so I could save time by spending more money, but the results I've gotten from the regimen I've put together are undeniable! My skin looks firmer, healthier, and younger. However, this is one product I regularly skip. The caffeine solution and Snail Mucin Eye Cream I feel make this unnecessary, so I am not likely to continue using it.
My lids had begun to relax a little too much even with other eye serums. This product helped lift them back up where they belong. Also helps with puffiness in the mornings.
I've been using this product for over a month and have not noticed any difference. I feel like the serum causes my checks to be more sensitive.
I've been using this product for almost a year and have noticed ZERO change in the appearance of my undereye. Don't waste your money!
I turned 30 recently and didn't like my under eyes. This helps SO much and within the first few uses I saw changes.
I was noticing my lids starting to droop a little and crows feet even though I was using Olay religiously. I switched to The Ordinary products and turned back the clock at least several years!
Got a crazy rash all around my eyes after the first use, been a week and it is still healing up.

At 38 w/ light circles and slight crepe to my eye area, I added this serum to my skincare. It's been 4 days, and I have already noticed an improvement - most notably my undereye looks more awake, more hydrated and visibly reduced fine lines.
Quality product, reasonable price for mature skin (normal to oily).

This product works. I have both under eye serums and this one is by far the best. I can now write a legitimate review after so much use that this eye serum actually works. It shouldn't dry out or burn it's just an oily base. It takes away my dark circles I don't have puffy under eyes only dark circles. I have very sensitive skin that easily breaks out as well this and the product with the pink color are by far the best on here and I've used many.

Within maybe five minutes of applying this eye serum as directed I felt a burning, tingling sensation around one eye. I immediately washed it off and the sensation went away. I have NEVER had a reaction like this to a skin care product and I try a lot of random products. Everything else I've tried from this brand has been good, but I will be returning this.

Been using Ordinary products-follow their suggested combos-for years, and I swear by it, I constantly am told I look 10-15 years younger than my age and since there is no additives or fragrances, it doesn't irritate my skin.
This eye serum gave me a horrible rash and made my eyes swell. I've never experienced this with another product. Do not recommend!

avis.titre: The only thing that has helped with under eye circles
avis.texte: I used the eye serum for several months before I started seeing results, now I am seeing huge results. My dark circles have lightened up so much! My crows feet still look pretty noticeable but I can deal with it!
Absorbs fast, light weight, non greasy & doesn't affect eye makeup. Just waiting to see some results.
I've never had sensitivity to products around my eyes. This one instantly caused burning, redness, Puffiness and actually hurts as it recovers from the burn. Very disappointed.
Love this product It makes my skin feel so nice and it looks great

Luckily, I did not have an allergic reaction like some other reviewers did, but it just feels like I am applying water on my eyelids. It does not do anything as far as I can tell, no moisturizing effect, no smoothing, nothing.

i recieved a full size of this in a beauty break sample set and i was excited. i finally used this and my undereyes felt super hot in a matter of seconds and started to turn red, i immediately washed it off and felt better. i dont have sensitive skin and NEVER get reactions so i hope i dont wake up with any but after seeing some other reviews now, i think i am 😭 please beware and stay away all together

Ive always had super dark under eyes and ive tried countless under eye creams and serums but this one is literally the only one that has worked. I would highly recommend this and I have gotten some of my friends using it and they all love it too! Such an amazing product!!

avis.titre: Use with caution - bad reaction on my eyelid
avis.texte: I have used twice under my eyes and both times I had a bad reaction on my right eyelid. I did not put the product on my eyelid only under eyes. My right eyelid both times got very puffy and sore. I have a bump I can feel and it very tender and irritated. I recommend using with caution if you try this product.

I've been using this serum since soon after The Ordinary introduced it. First one I bought, 2nd and 3rd were free with purchase during last Slowvember. I really never thought it did much until I ran out and didn't repurchase right away. The 11 lines between my brows came back with a vengeance within a week after it was gone!!!! My forehead lines also looked more prominent(I usually just spread the excess across my forehead after doing my eye area). This product really works with regular, sustained use!!!

I've tried other under eye creams and had little luck treating sun damage from blisters I sustained in my teen years. This is the only thing that has made a difference. Plus I love how easy it spreads and how little I have to use. Cost is great too.

I had been using this product for almost a year and loved it but recently started having a severe allergic reaction. I got rashes around my eyes and my eyelids are puffy, swollen, and dry. Not sure if they changed an ingredient recently but I would not recommend.

avis.titre: Great for those little under eye lines
avis.texte: I received this product free of charge in exchange for my honest opinion and review. I have fine lines and wrinkles under and around my eyes. After using this for a while, I could see a noticeable difference in these problems. It went on really smooth, leaving my under eyes hydrated.

avis.titre: It created Milia under my eyes
avis.texte: After using this product for about 3 weeks I started to notice skin bumps under my eyes. Now I have to deal with diminish the milia. Not recommended
Makes my skin feel smoother and firmer. Lines are definitely lighter. I use it in conjunction with The Ordinary Retinol 1%.

Ever since I started using this, I feel I've noticed a change in my under eye! Less dark circles and less puffiness! I use it when doing my skincare routine! I think it really helps with preventing creasing under the eye when using concealer as well. I would buy it again!
I usually have no issues with the brands products but this one in particular caused severe allergic reaction where it was applied - a long lasting redness and itchy rash.
I don't think this product does anything for me. 5 months of daily use and no visible change. Glad I got it for free!

I've been using this for 4 months now and I've had noticeable improvements. I used to have mild crows feet and fine lines around my eye contour area, and now they are barely noticeable and under eye bags aren't as bad either. With using only one drop a day, I still have 1/3 left of my bottle! Highly recommend.
Very disappointing used it for three months and haven't seen any difference. My eyes are still puffy.
I usually love Ordinary products, but this is absolutely useless product. Have not seen any improvements. Using it for 2 months and cannot wait till it finishes, so I can try other product.

avis.titre: The most effective beauty product I've ever used
avis.texte: I started using this last year as I had developed a significant eye bag on one side of my face. I thought there was some noticeable improvement by the time I'd got through the first bottle (applying every morning) but when it ran out, I didn't replace it for 4 weeks and I was really surprised how quickly the eyebag returned. I've just finished my second bottle and the improvement between now and when I started is huge. I definitely wouldn't be without it!
This serum works amazing! Unlike others that i have used, it doesnt leave my skin feeling dry and it doesnt burn. If used correctly, you will see results!
Please never stop making this. It is the only thing that gets rid of my eye bags. I have tried very expensive creams and nothing works like this does. Amazing.

avis.titre: Made my eyes swollen, red and super dry!
avis.texte: I'm 39 and always looking for a product that will be help with wrinkles. I rarely have a reaction from a product but this one led to awful side effects!! I didn't change anything else in my routine so this has to be the culprit. I really wanted to love it!!
This product gets 2 starts for the lack of negative side effects. On that note, this did absolutely nothing. Used this product as directed for 4 months. Saw no effects.

avis.titre: Product is great… packaging not great
avis.texte: I bought this and loved it! I was skeptical because I haven't found anything before this that actually helped with the fine lines under my eyes. But this actually started to work and I was very impressed. Then the dropper part of the bottle snapped off the top and the serum dried out and most of it went to waste unfortunately.

It absorbs quickly wnd does well under makeup. Out of all the pricier eye products I've tried, this one actually made a noticable difference to me (not drastic). I'm satisfied with the product and price point. I will definitely buy again and would recommend.
I love this product SO much, it makes my eyes feel so hydrated and in a week, I can see a reduction in my dark circles under my eyes!

Gifted during a Black Friday deal, I was excited to use this eye serum into my skincare routine, expecting the usual positive results I've come to associate with The Ordinary. Unfortunately, the morning after my first use, I woke up to a severely swollen face, to the extent that opening my eyes was a struggle. Initially thought this reaction to a possible food allergy, I gave my body two weeks to recover before attempting to use the serum again. Regrettably, the second application resulted in a similarly severe reaction, confirming my suspicions that this specific product was the culprit. Alongside the swelling, I also experienced an itchy throat, a symptom that was both unexpected and concerning.

I received this product for free as there was this deal for black friday month. Turns out this product was the cause of 3 months struggling with undereye redness. It really is difficult to believe that such an expensive product could ruin my life for 3 months! This made me really upset about The Ordinary as i'm a loyal client and have tried over 15 of their products. Do not risk your undereyes, it's not fun

I think this is a pretty good product. I do have sensitive skin and it does cause a slight stinging only on my upper cheek area right under my eye after applying so I don't use it daily and try to avoid getting it in that area and/or rinsing the area after. Otherwise it's fine
Husband and I both used it. It was fine for him. For me, it stung at first, and then I had an allergic reaction with itchy/swelling/redness around my eyes. Can't recommend.
I have been using this for about a week and I could tell a difference immediately and I am very impressed by how noticeable its been its such a short time. I highly recommend this product.

avis.titre: Stings under-eye skin but NIOD doesn't
avis.texte: I bought this to try instead of my regular NIOD FECC to compare effectiveness because it's a lot cheaaper. I found this stings my under-eye skin though so it's not acceptable for me to continue using. I've tried it 3 times, each time a month or two apart, layered on top of other serums or by itself, and my skin just doesn't like something in this. It stings/burns a little, with like an annoying 2/10 level of pain. The NIOD FECC doesn't sting at all, so I'll just continue using that. I definitely won't be getting this again or recommending it to anyone.

I am a longtime user of Deciem products and the Hylamide eye serum was a ride or die product for me. I have used two bottles of this trying to find what I lost when Deciem was bought out and the Hylamide line discontinued, but this Multi-Peptide Eye Serum is not it. I really do not think I am reaping any benefits from this serum. I really am disappointed that the Hylamide eye serum no longer exists.
I don't generally write reviews especially about skincare ! But had too !!! The serum is amazing my under eye bags, dark circles and 50 yr old wrinkles have gone

avis.titre: Buy it you won't regret it
avis.texte: Great product. Skin around my eyes feels nice and fresh. Eyes seem like I am looking younger. Packaging is good and gives a lot for the price. I have already picked up more.

I have a face that tends to be dry. This product is a game changer! I've used Vanicream face moisturizer for a long time, which is great. Now, I use a smaller amount mixed with two small drops of this. Together, the products are even better! I cannot recommend adding a little of this to your moisturizer enough! If your skin gets dry while you are retinol and other products like that, then this is the boost you need afterwards.
I did not see a difference while using this product. The application was pretty easy, but sometimes the dropper made it hard to be precise with application.

I love The Ordinary products and have used several products for years - so I was excited to try the Multi-Peptide Eye Serum. 24 hour patch test seemed normal. Then I used it for three days under my eyes (only 1x/day) and on the third day my face felt itchy, and I swelled up under my eyes. There's scattered red puffy patches under my eyes, on my forehead, cheeks and chin (so not just where I applied the serum). Nothing else about my skin routine has changed. I am taking benedryl to help with the itch and inflammation but it's been a few days and unfortunately, it's still red, puffy and itchy. Seeing other comments about similar reactions.
I used the whole bottle with no change at all in the way my eyes looked.
On the third day of use, a burning sensation and the effect of tear-stained eyes appeared in the morning.

I absolutely love this product! This is now a staple in my routine every morning and night! This product has helped with my dark circles, my under eye tiredness, and hydration. It has also helped with my milia on my upper eye. Love, love, love this!!
Been using for 2.5 months. I wasnt expecting to see any difference to my shiners' but I see zero difference for my undereye lines too. A little goes a long way but what's the point if it's useless.
I dont love this at all. Its runny in consistency and i haven't noticed a difference at all I much prefer the caffeine one

avis.titre: Did the opposite of what it claims
avis.texte: I use and love many of The Ordinary products and didn't think this one would be any different. I had fine lines and slight dark circles under my eyes so thought this would help to minimise them but what it's actually done is made things so much worse. I now have dry, saggy, wrinkly skin under my eye and large, dark bags. The skin is also now incredibly sensitive and stings all the time, even when I'm not using any products. I look like I've aged at least 10 years. I've stopped using this product and I really hope the damage is not permanent as I hate the way I now look. - from fine lines to deep, saggy wrinkles under my eyes. If anyone else has experienced anything similar, is this a permanent change?

This sounded like a really great product for me. I have chronic dark circles no matter how much sleep I get, and my under eyes are slightly puffy and the only place where my skin shows age with a few small wrinkles. I was so excited to try this. I patch tested on the skin right below my ear where it's a little sensitive, and I didn't have issues 24 hours later. I tried it under my eyes after the results from the patch test, expecting things to be just fine. First night and morning were fine, so were the second morning and night. But the third morning and night left me with redness and irritation below my eyes the next morning. I've had to slather Vaseline around my eyes to calm my skin after this product left my skin so uncomfortable and tight. This was the only change to my routine, so I know the adverse effects are from this product. I wouldn't recommend this if you have sensitive skin, or even if you have average skin like me. If your thin skin under your eyes can handle harsher things like acids and retinols, this shouldn't cause you any issues. I'm hoping the ordinary can come up with an effective under eye product that helps with dark circles, puffiness, wrinkles, and hydration without causing so much irritation!
I have used many eye serums in the past, but this has been one of my favorites! It goes on very easily and I'm noticing a real difference around my eyes. The scent is also nice and clean.

avis.titre: Very difficult to use  and consistency too runny!
avis.texte: The products packaging design is fiddly and it's almost impossible to apply as by the time you've put some drops on your fingertips, the product runs away. In trying g to manage applying the product while putting the dropper back into the bottle I knocked the bottle over with the dropper and so wasted the whole bottle.
I'm 68 my skin can be dry I didn't notice anything to make me buy it again . Maybe better for the younger crowd
I absolutely love this. It is a must have!! My under eyes are super dry and the bags are awful but since l've been using this they stay super moisturized and the lines have softened up tremendously!!

I didn't have high hopes for this product simply because I thought I needed medical intervention for my under eye area. It was looking so crepey and lines were showing a lot with makeup on, even with eye creams. I now use this day and night, I noticed the result the first day! I am actually blown away. My under eye looks smooth and hydrated. Not crepey at all. I will continue to buy this!
I am not sure that it works but it sure feels nice on my eyes. I love The Ordinary products, so it may take a little while to know if it works. This is my first time trying this formula.

Despite the higher price, I bought this eye serum because I have A LOT of under-eye concerns. The area is dark, with fine lines, sunken, and does not even feel like skin texture no matter how much I moisturize or how much sleep I get. After just one use, my eye area looked more firm and less dark. My mom even asked if I was wearing makeup, and a friend asked what I use because it worked so well on me. It did not have the same dramatic effects on her, which I think explains the polarizing reviews: its efficacy will depend on your eye's needs. But I love it, it helps with fine lines and darkness a looot. For me, it's magic!

I have struggled with hereditary dark circles my entire life, and now at 51, these circles are exacerbated by the crepey skin and fine lines I'm getting under the eye, and daytime puffiness along the orbital bone. I wish I could say I've noticed more improvement from the multipeptide serum, but I've used it for 2 months now, and have actually questioned whether my undereye area is getting worse. It's possible there has been some improvement in the very fine lines along the outer edge of my dark circle area, but the inner corners of each under eye has developed a crepiness to the skin that just doesn't seem like it was there before I started using the multi-peptide serum. It looks terrible with concealer. I'm going to give the serum a little more time. I just recently added the caffeine solution on top of it, and love the almost immediate relief I'm getting from the dark circles and puffiness now.

I used this product over 12 months ago, however, for whatever reason my review was not published. So I switched to this product after using another brand product which mind you, worked extremely well. Big mistake for me. This multi-peptide serum actually aged my under eye area and showed more wrinkles pretty much within a week of use. I continued to use the product daily until it ran out and vowed never to by it again. I have since gone back to using the other under eye cream I was using.

I bought this today and was very excited to try it. I use many The Ordinary skin care products. Unfortunately this serum caused a lot of burning and I washed it off. I don't usually have sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Unfortunately not as good as Hylamide Subq Eyes
avis.texte: I really wanted to love this. But it doesn't work als well on my 48 year old eyelids as Subq eyes. Before Hylamide was discontinued I bought several bottles. I would go through a bottle of multi-peptide eye serum, then use up a bottle of Subq eyes, then again multi-peptide eye serum etc. Everytime during the multi-peptide phase my eyelids became more crepe-y and dry, while with Subq they became plump again. It would be so great if The Ordinary could add the Subq formula to the range... NIOD's FECC is unfortunately financially out of reach for me, otherwise I would have tried that long ago.
It melts into the skin. Very luxurious feeling, and it has really helped puffiness and dark circles. Probably the best one I've tried so far. I will repurchase

I have always been into eye creams, this was my first try at serum and it changed my stance! It is so moisturizing and has helped really brighten up my under eyes. It's not too oily where it leaves me breaking out.

avis.titre: Too sticky, too shiny, irritates eyes
avis.texte: I am un able to use Caffeine Serum, irritates eyes badly. Thought I'd try this one. It is expensive for only 15 ml., But one drop easily does both eyes. But I'm disappointed that it is similar to other Ordinary serums inthat it dries down to a very sticky,shi n yfilm. Asa man,I don't put concealer over it,so itdoesnotlooknatural at all,very shinyfinish. Itdoes seemto de-puff, but it irritates my eyes. Will not buy again
Caused cystic pimples and dry skin. Don't recommend to those who are acne prone.
I love the way this serum felt on my skin. It wasn't overly sticky like other formulas I've tried. It helped brighten my dark circles and firm. It's at a really great price point too!

I received this with my order and was excited to try it. The first time I used it was fine, didn't notice any difference (it was also the first time) but the second morning I put it on, it caused such burning, which is not something you want right on the delicate skin around your eyes. Even after washing it off it persisted for about 15-20 minutes. Not a fun time! Seeing other reviews, it looks like some other people had the exact same thing.

I have dark circles, puffiness, and dehydrated skin around my eyes. This addressed the dryness okay, but it didn't do much after a couple months of use, which is weird considering my skin usually responds very well to peptides. The size to price ratio was a little shocking for the Ordinary but one bottle lasted ages. One little drop was all I needed for both eyes so I'm guessing they're charging "per use" here. Still, a rare miss for the Ordinary.
Love this eye serum its so refreshing and hydrates the skin. I have noticed a huge difference in the skin around my eyes. I am about to order more 10/10 recommend

I received this free with my November order , I've been using it for two weeks and my eyes feel firmer and very soft. No stinging or burning. You only need a drop per eye, there is no stickiness and it sinks in straight away. I'm yet to see if it helps with my wrinkles and crows feet. Would highly recommend

I only used this product once and the next day i woke up and my eyes were red from then on it's gotten worse in pain and started peeling and my eyes are puffy it's been nearly a month since only using it once and my eyes still haven't heeled

The Ordinary Multi-Peptide Eye Serum is a great little "tool" to help with the fine lines and wrinkles around your eyes. When you apply it, you can almost feel it working immediately. The caffeine in it makes your skin come alive and plump up! This has become a staple in my face care routine.

I'm on my second bottle and use this with Le Dieux eye patches each morning. Let it sit for 20 minutes minimum while I drink my morning coffee. To date, this is the only product that helps with my "aging eye puffiness ". There is no cure for aging skin, and I will continue to age (Good Lord permitting), but this definitely helps better than any other product I've tried. Give this product time to work, it takes YEARS for your skin to age, so it may take a month or so to help reverse it. This 58 year old lady really likes this product. Signed , a Skin Care Junkie
I received The ordinary muti-peptide eye serum for free, for my honest opinion. I think the product is great, i have dark areas under my eyes. This product has helped with that

I wish I had taken before and after pics. I was just starting to get some fine lines due to surface dehydration. I started using this and my skin is fine line free. It keeps my eye skin hydrated throughout the day and there's no irritation. I'm quite happy with how this product works on my skin. I use a heavier moisturizer over it and it doesnt pill or break up my makeup.
As a professional makeup artist I would have to say that this eye serum is average. It isn't a bad product, but it isn't anything overly amazing either.
Not certain if this actually does anything but I will use it until the bottle runs out anyways. Love the dropped bottle and trust the ordinary as a brand.

avis.titre: Yes, I would buy this product again.
avis.texte: I really like this serum.The Ordinary Multi Peptide Anti Aging Eye serum it helps my dark circles and my puffy eyes, and it helps my fine lines to do it consistently every day.

I recieved a free bottle as part of my Slowvember order - and I've found it to be excellent. I've no unrealistic expectations of overnight transformation - also - no issue with the cost of The Ordinary products from me. I'm in my 60's and apply the serum on bare skin after cleansing - I don't use it with anything other than Natural Moisturising Factors. I've never found a problem with pilling - you only need a drop of this per eye (if that). It leaves my eye/undereye feeling and looking refreshed - I was not expecting my crowsfeet to go anywhere - but again, the serum left my skin refreshed and happy. I'm expecting this little bottle to last ages and I'd happily purchase it when it runs out

avis.titre: Works well with my sensitive skin!
avis.texte: I received this item with my order as part of a Black Friday special. I had been looking for an under eye treatments to help with dark circles and fine lines, but have been weary to try products due to my sensitive skin. I have been using this product in the morning and evenings for about 2 weeks now. I have seen reduction in my dark circles and more smoothness than before. I use it in addition to the cleanser, hyaluronic acid serum, and daily moisterizer. I have not had any other stinging or rawness that others have posted about. Even though the serum is small, you only need to use a very small amount so I think it will last a while!
I got it as a sample with my order and very happy with the results. Excellent on fine lines around the eye, not irritating for me and my skin is sensitive.

avis.titre: My skin didn't agree with this Serum
avis.texte: I had red patches under both eyes.. and it stung really bad… I gave it a good go but obviously didn't agree with my skin!!

This is the most horrible product I ever used. Extremely disappointed, especially since I'm a big fan of the brand. This serum made my upper eyelids saggy and OLD. I have been using it for a month and that was the only new treatment in my routine, so there is nothing else that could have ruined my skin. My eyelids look saggy, old and tired , skin texture is uneven and unhealthy. I am shocked tbh, not sure how am I going to try to fix it.
As soon as I used the product, the next day, I started to have small red patches around my eyes :( it's not a product for me, unfortunately. I'm going to give it away. Otherwise, I liked the texture.
